Context: V. Casual Employees

| (i) | Casual employees drawing minimum of wages as notified by the Ministry of Labour or the State Government / UT Administration, whichever is higher. | Ys th of the daily wage. |
| (ii) | Casual employees drawing Y3oth of the pay at the minimum of the relevant pay scale plus DA for work of 8 hours a day. | Minimum of the relevant pay scale plus DA admissible at the rates divided by (30 x 8). |
| (iii) | Casual workers having temporary status. | As admissible for office staff as in Para. II above. |
